titleZh: 单元复习:我在西雅图的一周
goalZh: 读懂并会讲一段描述一周生活的短文,复习时间、作息、第三人称 -s 和频率副词
canDoZh: 能用一段话讲讲自己普通的一周:上课、打工、运动和周末

newItems.noteZh: ir 要卷舌,词尾 d 轻轻收住;I'm tired. 我累了。
th 是浊音 /ð/;讲顺序:I have lunch, then I go to the library。
after class 下课后,after work 下班后。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Hi, you guys! Here's my week in Seattle.
lines.zh: 嗨,大家好!给你们看看我在西雅图的一周。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I have class on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday mornings.
lines.zh: 我每周一、周三、周五上午有课。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: On Tuesdays and Thursdays, I have a part-time job.
lines.zh: 每周二和周四,我做一份兼职。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I work at the cafe from two to six.
lines.zh: 我在咖啡馆上班,从两点到六点。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: After work, I have dinner. Then I often study in the library.
lines.zh: 下班以后我吃晚饭,然后常常去图书馆学习。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I usually go to bed at eleven.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: My roommate, Ethan, gets up at noon.
lines.zh: 我的室友伊森中午才起床。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: He plays video games at night and sleeps in the morning!
lines.zh: 他晚上打游戏,上午睡觉!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: On the weekend, I sleep late and do laundry.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Every Sunday, I call my parents. I miss them every day.
lines.zh: 每个周日我都给爸妈打电话。我每天都想他们。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I'm busy, and I'm sometimes tired.

questions.prompt: 磊每周哪几天去咖啡馆打工?
questions.explainZh: On Tuesdays and Thursdays, I have a part-time job.——每周二、周四下午两点到六点。周一、三、五上午他有课。

questions.prompt: 下班以后,磊一般做什么?
options: 先吃晚饭,再去图书馆学习
questions.explainZh: After work, I have dinner. Then I often study in the library.——after 是"在……之后",then 是"然后"。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一项说的是伊森?
options: 中午才起床,晚上打游戏
questions.explainZh: My roommate, Ethan, gets up at noon. He plays video games at night and sleeps in the morning!

questions.prompt: 磊觉得在西雅图的生活怎么样?
options: 每天都很轻松,有点无聊
很忙,有时很累,但很喜欢这里
questions.explainZh: I'm busy, and I'm sometimes tired. But I love it here!——他想家(I miss them every day),但很喜欢这里。

grammar.titleZh: 复习:一般现在时的两种形式
grammar.bodyZh:
说习惯和作息都用一般现在时。I / you / we / they 用动词原形:I work at the cafe.;he / she 或一个人的名字后面,动词加 -s:Ethan gets up at noon.。
否定和疑问用 don't / doesn't、Do / Does,后面的动词都回到原形:I don't work on Mondays. / Does Ethan study at night?。
朗读时把每个 -s 读清楚:gets /s/、plays /z/、watches /ɪz/。

examples.text: I work at the cafe from two to six.
examples.zh: 我在咖啡馆上班,从两点到六点。

examples.text: Ethan gets up at noon and plays video games at night.
examples.zh: 伊森中午起床,晚上打游戏。

examples.text: Does Ethan study at night? — No, he doesn't.

grammar.titleZh: 复习:频率副词和 at / on / in
grammar.bodyZh:
频率副词放在行为动词前、be 动词后:I usually go to bed at eleven. / I'm sometimes tired.。
时间介词:at + 钟点(at eleven);on + 星期(on Tuesdays、on the weekend);in + 时段(in the morning、in the afternoon),但 at night。
every day、every Sunday 前面不加介词:不说 on every Sunday。

examples.text: I usually go to bed at eleven.
On Tuesdays and Thursdays, I work in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 每周二和周四,我下午上班。

grammar.titleZh: 用 then 和 after 把事情串起来
grammar.bodyZh:
讲一天的安排时,用 then(然后)和 after(在……之后)把事情按顺序连起来,听的人更容易跟上。
after + 名词:after class(下课后)、after work(下班后)、after lunch(午饭后);放在句首时后面加逗号:After work, I have dinner.。
then 放在第二件事前面:I have dinner. Then I study.;也可以说 I have dinner, and then I study.。
发音:then 的 th 是浊音 /ð/,舌尖轻放在上下齿之间、声带振动,别读成 "zen" 或 "den"。

examples.text: I have dinner. Then I study in the library.
examples.zh: 我吃晚饭,然后去图书馆学习。
